raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What does this PR do?

When every rollout in a prompt group gets the same fractional reward, there is no preference between them, so every advantage in the group should be exactly zero. In `_post_process_rewards` the group is centered in float32, and for identical rewards that can leave a residue of about an ulp instead of zero. With std normalization on, the residue is then divided by its own std, which turns it into a small nonzero advantage shared by the whole group.

Small reproduction on current main (a group of 16 rollouts that all scored 0.3, `grpo` with `grpo_std_normalization`):

- centered reward for each rollout: `+2.98e-08` instead of `0`
- advantage after std division: about `+0.0298` for every rollout in the group (0.6 gives about `+0.0596`, 0.9 about `-0.0596`)

So a group where all samples earned the same partial credit still pushes the policy, always in the same direction for the whole group. I ran into the same class of problem in the Miles fork's copy of this code (RadixArk/miles#4019, fixed there); this repo's version has the same arithmetic, so I am sending the fix here as well.

## The change

`slime/data/batch_builder.py`, inside `_post_process_rewards`: if a group's rewards are all finite and all equal, write exact zeros for that group and skip the centering for it. Everything else is unchanged. Groups with a NaN or an infinite reward are deliberately left alone, so a bad reward keeps propagating as NaN instead of being quietly turned into zero.

This covers `grpo`, `gspo`, `cispo` and `reinforce_plus_plus_baseline`, since they all share this normalization block.

## Tests

New cases in `tests/test_grouped_rewards.py`:

- `test_uniform_fractional_rewards_have_exactly_zero_advantage`: rewards 0.3, 0.1 + 0.2 and 0.9, 16 rollouts in one group, for all four estimators, with std normalization on and off. All advantages exactly 0. (On main, the 24 cases with std normalization or the centering residue fail.)
- `test_uniform_group_next_to_mixed_group`: a uniform group batched with a mixed [1, 0, 0, 0] group. Only the uniform group is zeroed.
- `test_uniform_nonfinite_rewards_stay_nonfinite`: uniform NaN and infinite groups stay NaN.

Run locally:

```
pytest tests/test_grouped_rewards.py -q
36 passed

pre-commit run --files slime/data/batch_builder.py tests/test_grouped_rewards.py
all hooks passed
```

A note on assistance: this change was drafted with AI help. I reviewed every line and ran the reproduction and the tests myself, and I am happy to adjust anything.

Thank you for taking a look, and for slime in general. Guidance on scope or style is very welcome.

nodes.body: The nonzero advantages for uniform fractional rewards reproduce on `main`. I ran the grouped-reward tests at `0063710` on CPU with PyTorch 2.13.0: uniform groups produce exact zeros, and the mixed-group and nonfinite-reward cases pass too. I did not run an end-to-end training job.
Thank you for checking, and for reproducing it on main as well. Glad the tests hold up on your side too. Happy to run anything else you would like to see here.

@@ -241,7 +241,18 @@ def _post_process_rewards(self, samples: list[Sample] | list[list[Sample]]):
                 groups.setdefault(group, []).append(position)
             rewards = torch.tensor([value[1] for value in rollouts.values()], dtype=torch.float)
             for positions in groups.values():
-                centered = rewards[positions] - rewards[positions].mean()
+                group_rewards = rewards[positions]
+                if torch.isfinite(group_rewards).all() and (group_rewards == group_rewards[0]).all():
+                    # Every rollout in the group got the same reward, so
+                    # every advantage is exactly zero. Centering identical
+                    # float32 rewards can still leave a residue of about
+                    # an ulp, and dividing that by its own std turns it
+                    # into a small nonzero advantage shared by the whole
+                    # group. Non-finite rewards skip this on purpose, so
+                    # a NaN in the group keeps propagating as NaN.
+                    rewards[positions] = torch.zeros_like(group_rewards)
+                    continue
+                centered = group_rewards - group_rewards.mean()
                 if (
                     self.args.advantage_estimator in ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo"]
                     and self.args.grpo_std_normalization

@@ -99,6 +99,39 @@ def test_disabled_normalization_preserves_outcome_rewards():
     assert builder(rewards_normalization=False)._post_process_rewards(samples) == ([1, 1, 0], [1, 1, 0])
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("estimator", ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo", "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("std", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("reward", [0.3, 0.1 + 0.2, 0.9])
+def test_uniform_fractional_rewards_have_exactly_zero_advantage(estimator, std, reward):
+    # Every rollout in the group got the same reward, so there is no
+    # preference between them and every advantage must be exactly zero.
+    # Centering identical float32 rewards used to leave a residue of
+    # about an ulp, which the std division amplified into a small
+    # nonzero advantage shared by the whole group (about +0.03 for 0.3).
+    samples = [segment(1, i, reward) for i in range(16)]
+    raw, normalized = builder(advantage_estimator=estimator, grpo_std_normalization=std)._post_process_rewards(samples)
+    assert raw == [reward] * 16
+    assert normalized == [0.0] * 16
+
+
+def test_uniform_group_next_to_mixed_group():
+    samples = [segment(1, i, 0.3) for i in range(4)] + [
+        segment(2, 10, 1),
+        segment(2, 11, 0),
+        segment(2, 12, 0),
+        segment(2, 13, 0),
+    ]
+    _, normalized = builder()._post_process_rewards(samples)
+    assert normalized == pytest.approx([0, 0, 0, 0, 0.75, -0.25, -0.25, -0.25])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("reward", [float("nan"), float("inf")])
+def test_uniform_nonfinite_rewards_stay_nonfinite(reward):
+    samples = [segment(1, i, reward) for i in range(4)]
+    _, normalized = builder(grpo_std_normalization=True)._post_process_rewards(samples)
+    assert all(math.isnan(v) for v in normalized)
+
